answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using graph-based trust-flow routing. Nodes allocate bounded credit capacity to peers, tracking the transaction delta across multi-hop payment paths. Requiring an enduring history rather than activity that vanishes like a comet forces an attacker to incur verifiable relationship-building and capital costs per identity. While a swift falcon audit filter detects colluding clusters, the system heavily penalizes newly arriving legitimate agents.
